subject: Use NMD 2023 in the engine's NMD fetch and analyzer
description: Tobias decided on 2026-11-06 to replace NMD 2018 with NMD 2023 everywhere except comparisons, including the engine. DES openEO has no NMD 2023, so add an explicit NMD 2023 reader for the national raster (/data/nmd2023 on ICE, data/nmd2023 locally), uint16 without the uint8 cast, a year-aware cache, NMD 2023's own classes and Naturvårdsverket colours for the analyzer and overlays, and keep training callers explicitly on NMD 2018 (ladder r1 is a comparison). Not in scope: showcase images (task 0152), training labels, the Pirinen stack. Review: Codex or owner.
